title: Vomit: Clean up Claude 5's token output with a separate LLM
summary: Vomit is a developer tool that uses a separate LLM to clean up and repair the raw streaming output from Claude 5, handling issues like incomplete tokens, truncation, and formatting artifacts that commonly occur during LLM response streaming.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of messy, incomplete, or corrupted streaming output from Claude 5 by using a secondary LLM to intelligently clean up and complete the text.
why_valuable: It provides a reliable way to handle streaming LLM output edge cases, ensuring developers get clean, usable text even when tokens are cut off mid-stream.
